canon_question_options_two_to_four.name: canon_question_options_two_to_four
canon_question_options_two_to_four.value: case when jsonb_typeof("canon_question"."options") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("canon_question"."options") between 2 and 4 else false end

canon_question_decided_iff_not_open.name: canon_question_decided_iff_not_open
canon_question_decided_iff_not_open.value: ("canon_question"."status" <> 'open') = ("canon_question"."decided_by" is not null) and ("canon_question"."status" <> 'open') = ("canon_question"."decided_at" is not null)

skill_capability_fields.name: skill_capability_fields
skill_capability_fields.value:
("skill"."type" = 'capability' and "skill"."grants" is not null and "skill"."io_shape" is not null)
				or ("skill"."type" = 'knowledge' and "skill"."grants" is null and "skill"."io_shape" is null)

export_gate_override_complete.name: export_gate_override_complete
export_gate_override_complete.value:
("export"."gate_override_gate" is null and "export"."gate_override_justification" is null and "export"."gate_override_by" is null and "export"."gate_override_at" is null)
				or ("export"."gate_override_gate" is not null and "export"."gate_override_justification" is not null and btrim("export"."gate_override_justification") <> '' and "export"."gate_override_by" is not null and "export"."gate_override_at" is not null)

intake_approval_complete.name: intake_approval_complete
intake_approval_complete.value: "intake"."status" <> 'approved' or ("intake"."approved_by" is not null and "intake"."approved_at" is not null and "intake"."mission_id" is not null)

intake_repo_read_complete.name: intake_repo_read_complete
intake_repo_read_complete.value: ("intake"."repo_url" is null and "intake"."repo_commit_sha" is null and "intake"."repo_read_at" is null) or ("intake"."repo_url" is not null and "intake"."repo_commit_sha" is not null and "intake"."repo_read_at" is not null)

dispatch_frozen_once_started.name: dispatch_frozen_once_started
dispatch_frozen_once_started.value: "dispatch"."status" = 'queued' or ("dispatch"."agent_identity_version_id" is not null and "dispatch"."agent_version_sha256" is not null and "dispatch"."skills_sha256" is not null and "dispatch"."model" is not null and "dispatch"."price_version" is not null)

finding_dispatch_idempotency_key_uq.name: finding_dispatch_idempotency_key_uq
finding_dispatch_idempotency_key_uq.where: "finding"."reported_by_dispatch_id" is not null and "finding"."idempotency_key" is not null

finding_idempotency_key_iff_dispatch.name: finding_idempotency_key_iff_dispatch
finding_idempotency_key_iff_dispatch.value: ("finding"."idempotency_key" is not null) = ("finding"."reported_by_dispatch_id" is not null)

finding_request_sha256_iff_key.name: finding_request_sha256_iff_key
finding_request_sha256_iff_key.value: ("finding"."request_sha256" is not null) = ("finding"."idempotency_key" is not null)

finding_dismissed_has_reason.name: finding_dismissed_has_reason
finding_dismissed_has_reason.value: "finding"."status" <> 'dismissed' or ("finding"."dismissed_reason" is not null and btrim("finding"."dismissed_reason") <> '')

mission_engagement_matches_origin.name: mission_engagement_matches_origin
mission_engagement_matches_origin.value: ("mission"."origin" = 'client' and "mission"."engagement_id" is not null) or ("mission"."origin" = 'internal' and "mission"."engagement_id" is null)

mission_override_has_rationale.name: mission_override_has_rationale
mission_override_has_rationale.value: "mission"."cut_source" <> 'overridden' or ("mission"."cut_rationale" is not null and btrim("mission"."cut_rationale") <> '')

mission_template_complete.name: mission_template_complete
mission_template_complete.value: ("mission"."template_ref" is null and "mission"."template_version" is null) or ("mission"."template_ref" is not null and "mission"."template_version" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$')
